496:t_10:19.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Give me a straight answer.」

496:t_10:21.en:
$$バナージ$$
(You're really persistent today, $$カミーユ$$...)

496:t_10:22.en:
$$シン$$
(Like $$クェス$$ said earlier, he probably has some things he can't stomach.)

496:t_10:23.en:
$n
(What'll you do, $$ギュネイ$$? $$カミーユ$$'s a tough opponent today.)

496:t_10:28.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「It's fine, $$クェス$$. We're no different.」

496:t_10:30.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「We don't really know what's right or what's best either.」

496:t_10:31.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「That's why we fight to find it. In other words, we're just like you.」

496:t_10:35.en:
$$クェス$$
「$$ギュネイ$$ said thank you!」

496:t_10:38.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Of course I am. I'm the man who's going to surpass the Colonel.」

496:t_10:40.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「It's fine. Until the Colonel returns, I'm counting on you to fill his place, $$ギュネイ$$.」

496:t_10:41.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Just watch. I won't settle for being a substitute.」

496:t_10:42.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then, to celebrate $$ギュネイ$$'s enlistment, I would like to perform our customary ritual.」

496:t_10:44.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Give it up. We've all been through it.」

496:t_10:45.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「If you refuse, he'll just keep pestering you.」

496:t_10:47.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then let's make this quick! Let's get fired up for another day of...!」

496:t_10:49.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「That's what you wanted, right!?」

496:t_10:50.en:
$$クェス$$
「That'll do, $$ギュネイ$$! I'm counting on you again from now on!」

496:t_10:52.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
(Colonel... From today on, I won't chase after you.)

496:t_10:53.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
(I'll fight shoulder to shoulder with you, and someday I'll definitely surpass you...)

496:t_10:60.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「...I wonder...what will happen to him now...」

496:t_10:61.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「His death hasn't been confirmed, but I don't believe he'll return to $$ネオ・ジオン$$.」

496:t_10:62.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「He seemed to understand your and $$シャア$$'s words in his own way.」

496:t_10:63.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Was I just meddling where I wasn't wanted...?」

496:t_10:65.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「If I said that, would you regret it, $$カミーユ$$?」

496:t_10:67.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then take pride in what you did.」

496:t_10:68.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「We should reflect, but have no regrets... That's how we humans want to live.」

496:t_10:70.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Now that you've cleared your head, let's get fired up for another day of...!」

496:t_10:72.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「How was that? Raising your voice clears your head, doesn't it?」

496:t_10:73.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「If I refused here, you'd never stop pestering me.」

496:t_10:75.en:
$$カミーユ$$
($$ギュネイ$$... Even if we meet again someday, somewhere, I'm sure I won't change the way I live.)

496:t_10:76.en:
$$カミーユ$$
(If you watched that man's example too, live honestly with yourself...)

497:t_000:1.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Captain $$ジンネマン$$, I'm counting on you to guard the $$ソレスタルビーイング号$$.」

497:t_000:5.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「No... I'm all right. Sorry to make you worry.」

497:t_000:6.en:
$$フォウ$$
「Don't worry about it. We look out for each other.」

497:t_000:7.en:
$$クェス$$
「Exactly. Besides, it's dangerous if you don't focus. $$ギュネイ$$...must be really worked up.」

497:t_000:9.en:
$$カツ$$
「Is that why the Colonel teamed up with $$カミーユ$$...?」

497:t_000:10.en:
$$シャア$$
「Don't worry about me, $$カミーユ$$. Move as you please.」

497:t_000:11.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「I can't do that. Even I can tell you're planning something, Colonel.」

497:t_000:13.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Do you know anything, $$シン$$?」

497:t_000:14.en:
$$シン$$
「I haven't heard anything, but if $$カミーユ$$ senses it, there must be something going on.」

497:t_000:15.en:
$$アムロ$$
「That's enough. Now that they've found our base, they may launch a large-scale offensive.」

497:t_000:16.en:
$$デュオ$$
「Still, I can't believe they found this ship.」

497:t_000:17.en:
$$カトル$$
「Does $$サイデリアル$$ have a way to see through our stealth?」

497:t_000:19.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「As a base for opposition to $$ネオ・ジオン$$, the $$ソレスタルビーイング号$$ has people coming and going.」

497:t_000:21.en:
$$ノイン$$
「No. As long as people are moving around, there is a possibility that those movements were detected.」

497:t_000:22.en:
$$刹那$$
「I'll concentrate on intercepting the enemy now.」

497:t_000:23.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「My and $$アレルヤ$$'s $$ガンダム$$s have powered up with additional equipment. We'll show them what they can do.」
